response: Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. Now you can lock in the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, then return to that setup in a single click instead of rebuilding it each time. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering personal workflows, client checklists, or sprint boards without running out of room. Views aren't limited to your own screen either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same filtered list, whether that's this week's priorities or overdue tasks. Saved Views works across every project and list in your workspace, and updates automatically as tasks change, so the view stays accurate without extra effort. Setting one up takes seconds, and there's nothing to configure beyond your first save. This is included in all paid plans at no additional cost, with no separate add-on or upgrade required. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
